name: Aizawa Shin
source:
Part of unit MAISY

Loves to read shoujo manga and is more pure-hearted than anyone, he dreams of having heart-pounding encounters.
Though he looks small and cute, he's a delinquent.
His choice of insults seem like they came from the Showa era.
